notes.title: The Judge is out now!
notes.notes: [p]Misaki Tetsumora is a well renowned judge who resides in the supernatural town of Kazemori. Where criminals of all kinds run amok.[/p][p]Humans, ghosts, thieves, serial killers, zombies, speeding ticket violators and demonic jerks to name a few. It's your job to help her choose the final verdict on each one of the criminals that come into her courtroom.[/p][p]But, be careful. Each choice comes with a different moral alignment. The judge is sexy, the criminals are nasty and the jury is just a talking skeleton who loves handing out guilty verdicts like candy on Halloween. By the end of the day, what kind of judge will you become? [/p][p]Time will tell in "The Judge". The final verdict is...[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3506330/The_Judge/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]*Play VR version for VR support*.[/p]
